about: I am a Machine Learning Engineer and Electrical Technician, currently pursuing an MSc in Electronics and Computer Engineering (ECE). My expertise lies at the intersection of artificial intelligence, data science, and engineering, with a particular interest in medical imaging, predictive modeling, and energy systems.My work focuses on developing machine learning and deep learning solutions for real-world challenges, including medical image analysis, time-series forecasting, and energy consumption prediction. I am passionate about research, innovation, and transforming complex data into meaningful and practical solutions.
